sources.snippet: For the first time, Qwen3.8 brings a Qwen-Max-class model to open release. Built on the architectural foundation of Qwen3.5, Qwen3.8 delivers substantial gains across coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks. sources.snippet: Empero is an independent AI research lab in Germany building small, efficient language models you can own and run yourself. Latest: Qwen3.8 distilled to 9B / 4B / 2B, and a GDN-aware 27B Ridge GGUF at 11.7 GiB. 1M+ downloads on Hugging Face.
